original_post_text:
When You Speak With Honesty and Compassion, People Feel It

I want to share a small but meaningful moment with you all.

When I wrote my post about The Lodge situation, I made a conscious decision to lead with fairness and compassion rather than speculation and judgment. I didn’t know if anyone beyond the DFW poker community would even see it.

Well, Andrew Neeme reacted to the post.

For those who don’t know who Andrew Neeme is, he is widely considered the godfather of poker vlogging. He is the pioneer who showed the world that the poker lifestyle was worth capturing and sharing. He inspired an entire generation of content creators, myself included, to pick up a camera and tell their stories. Without Andrew Neeme, the poker content community as we know it looks completely different.
Andrew is also one of the principal partners of The Lodge Card Club. So when I say this situation hits close to home for him, I mean that in every sense of the word. This is his business, his passion, and his livelihood.

The fact that he took a moment in the middle of what has to be an incredibly stressful and difficult time to acknowledge this post means more to me than I can fully express. I want him and his wife Busi to know that the poker community sees everything they have built and we are rooting for them.

Speak with honesty. Lead with compassion. People will always feel when something is genuine.
Andrew, we’re with you. I hope The Lodge finds its way back to the felt very soon. 

#AndrewNeeme #TheLodge #TexasPoker #ShamGodPoker
